description: Massive budget. Massive brand. Absolutely dreadful ads. Some of the world's biggest companies are the worst offenders on paid. 🤦‍♂️
transcript: Global brands currently killing it with paid. Gymshark comes to mind as a business has been done brilliantly with paid. I think that would surprise a lot of people cause they're sort of think of Gymshark, you think of content and you don't realise that a lot of that content is paid. I think a lot of people would miss that element, but they've absolutely done a ton with paid. A lot of the massive businesses that everyone recognise, they're not actually great. They're sort of riding on brand. Our any like bank, insurance company, mortgage providers, all those like really dry businesses that could do such a better job with creative. They are so often just really dull. Partly it's because they're constrained by like what they can say in advertising, but I think also a big part of it is just terrified to actually try anything interesting or creative. I think a lot of the car brands are doing a terrible job with paid because I think what they've done is they've just taken their TV ads, all they've been doing for decades, and they put them on page and they all look the same for the most part as well. Like when was the last time you saw an influencer or UGC style video ad for a car? It's like super rare to see that type of content but that would cut through the noise massively instead of just here's the car sort of driving along with A bit of music in the background and talking about a few of the features with someone that their mouse not moving in sync with the audio that you can hear and stuff like that.
